reveal_en: Beneath your feet, an ancient network thrives. Trees share wisdom and resources through a vast fungal internet.
reveal_zh: 脚下，古老网络蓬勃生长。树木通过庞大真菌网络共享智慧与资源。
meaning_en: This unseen connection reveals nature's profound unity. Every living thing is part of a silent, symbiotic dance.
meaning_zh: 这种无形连接揭示了自然的深刻统一。万物皆是无声共生之舞的一部分。

visual.color: Deep moss green, luminous amber veins
